Generated seccomp filter for write and fsync on logfile and archive file descriptors.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp filter for the archiver writer path. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime CPU architecture, then allows only the `write` and `fsync` system calls when they use the expected file descriptors. The filter kills the process for any other system call or for a call that uses a different architecture or file descriptor. The function [`populate_sock_filter_policy_archiver_writer`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_archiver_writer>) copies the prepared filter instructions into the caller buffer for use with seccomp setup code.
